scope: Branch isolation, BranchScope, token leak, GDPR data minimization, FormRequest authz

findings.title: GDPR-leak risk: KDS Order broadcast channel for OrderStatusChanged is per-tenant — not per-branch — and ships customer name to every subscriber

evidence.comment_at_line_62: [Sprint 5A Z9-P0-03] GDPR data-minimization: customer.phone is shipped ONLY for DELIVERY orders. ... but JSON wire still leaked phone to all KDS WebSocket subscribers.

impact: customer.name is still shipped on ALL KDS payloads (kiosk/takeaway/dine-in/delivery) — not minimized to delivery only

If a multi-tenant deployment shares an Echo Pusher app key across tenants, names could leak cross-tenant via channel subscription escape (not verified, but worth confirming Pusher app-id-per-tenant isolation)
findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Audit Pusher app/key isolation (out of scope, see Z-6 Sync). Verify channel name includes branch_id prefix; restrict customer.name to dine-in/delivery only (kiosk/takeaway: queue_number suffices). Estimated 1h heal + 1h sentinel.
findings.audit_status: Read-verified — comment at line 62 acknowledges historic phone leak

findings.title: Branch isolation in KdsSyncController is correctly enforced

evidence.code_excerpt: $userBranchId = (int) ($user->branch_id ?? 0); $requestedBranchId = $request->query('branch_id'); $resolvedBranchId = $userBranchId; if ($userBranchId === 0) { /* admin global */ if ($requestedBranchId) $resolvedBranchId = (int) $requestedBranchId; } elseif ((int) $requestedBranchId !== $userBranchId) { return 403 'Cross-branch access is forbidden.'; }

findings.verdict: Branch isolation enforced server-side; explicit 403 for cross-branch staff attempt. Admin bypass (branch_id=0) honors explicit override. PASS.

findings.title: changeStatus enforces branch isolation under DB lock + optimistic concurrency
findings.verdict: FOR UPDATE lock + branch check + 409 conflict on stale expected_status. Audit log via [KDS_409] channel preserves attempted_status + user_id. PASS.

findings.title: FormRequest authz on changeStatus correctly restricts to kitchen roles

evidence.code_excerpt: public function authorize(): bool { if (! auth()->check()) return false; $user = auth()->user(); return method_exists($user, 'hasAnyRole') && $user->hasAnyRole(['Admin', 'Branch Manager', 'Chef', 'POS Operator', 'Cashier']); }

findings.verdict: Spatie role check on top of permission:kitchen-display-system middleware. Double-defense. PASS.

findings.title: Cache TTL 5s on KDS sync payload could leak admin-global data to a freshly downgraded staff user
findings.impact: Cache key correctly salted with branch_id. If admin sees 'all' then ROLE is reduced to staff branch X within 5s, the staff endpoint call uses branch_id=X which generates a DIFFERENT cache key. PASS — but worth a sentinel test asserting cache key salt includes branch context.
findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Add sentinel test: kds.sync cache key MUST include resolved branch_id. Estimated 30min.
findings.audit_status: Read-verified — actually a PASS but worth a sentinel

findings.title: KDS bump localStorage is shared across browser tabs of the SAME station regardless of user identity
findings.impact: Workstation handover: outgoing chef's bump state visible to incoming chef. Not a data-leak per se (only own-branch orders rendered) but operational confusion.

branch_isolation_check.branchscope_global_applied: PASS — Order model inherits BranchScope per CLAUDE.md §9 (Order is in 11-model post-iter11+12 list)
branch_isolation_check.cross_branch_403_on_stale_token: PASS — explicit abort(403) at controller AND service layers

summary_one_line: Branch isolation is exemplary (double-defense: controller + service + BranchScope). Only P1 finding is residual customer.name in KDS payload across all order types — historic GDPR phone leak was healed for phone only, name still ships.
